question: The microbiocidal action of iodine and chlorine and many of its derivatives is due to:

options.opb: They bind specifically to the active centers of the enzymes.
options.opc: They bind specifically to ribosomal proteins.
options.opd: They induce pores in the membranes.
options.ope: They cause the dissolution of membrane phospholipids.

analysis: Iodine and chlorine derivatives exhibit microbiocidal action by causing damage to microbial cells through oxidation processes.
